meaning_of_completion: All 12 scheduled milestones evaluated and evidence documented; NOT all hypotheses successful nor all reproducibility blockers removed.

policy_selection.name: SG057 early abstention on prefix-only evidence
policy_selection.description: Deterministic controller uses only observed prefixes. At t=220, if still unresolved and one of two frozen low-SE confidence-feature groups is authorized, abstain; otherwise continue to 240 and apply frozen SG052 directional decision.
policy_selection.selection_basis: Only tested early-adaptation policy with lower heldout modeled loss than wait under original cost weights; benefit remained on SG058 and SG059 synthetic stress tests.
non_adopted: SG054 initial early commitment: larger loss than wait
SG055 empirical ranked early commitment: larger loss than wait
policy_selection.diodic_invariant: Present action uses observed prefix only, future may not revise earlier actions; historical evidence append-only; tested noninterference is not formal proof.
policy_selection.hegemonic_invariant: One deterministic action rank and tie-break, with observe or abstain permitted; not competing authorities or votes.

aggregate_descriptive_only.warning: Totals are sums of three distinct synthetic holdouts; not a pooled external validation, not three independent source ancestries.

open_failure_register.detail: Published SG050 lacks three_way() called by SG051; SG052 lacks kind() called directly or indirectly downstream.
open_failure_register.exit_condition: Compatibility layer or new versioned modules pass isolated checkout, exact frozen outputs and hashes verified; historical evidence remains immutable.

open_failure_register.detail: SG059 onset165 produced 53 incorrect directional decisions out of 180; post-change samples may be too scarce for current trailing estimator.
open_failure_register.exit_condition: Predeclare a new test for unfamiliar late transitions and demonstrate lower wrong-decision cost on held-out mixtures.

open_failure_register.detail: SG059 candidate abstained on 514/720 streams and still made 69 wrong directional decisions.
open_failure_register.exit_condition: Calibrate uncertainty and decision cost on a genuinely distinct target distribution.

open_failure_register.detail: All experiments were constructed synthetic generators and controlled costs, not observed operational data; calibrations are not transferable by assumption.
open_failure_register.exit_condition: Acquire and preregister independent external or operational test data and stakes before any deployment assessment.

open_failure_register.detail: Hash-chain and prefix tests cover predefined perturbations, not formal verification of arbitrary software behavior.
open_failure_register.exit_condition: Module-level static guards plus tests including forbidden lookahead and chain tampering.
